requirements.text: Document every Person-bearing reference and its lifecycle behavior in the reviewed Person inventory. Each Person-bearing consumer registers resource/field, exact tenant ownership, current versus historical meaning, source/survivor concurrency outcomes, retirement treatment, merge rewrite rule, uniqueness/collision refusal, private ownership/authorship restriction, reviewed inverse policy and named fixtures. Every new reference validates the current active Person. A merge racing a new reference cannot leave a current reference on the retired source. WP-015 closes only then-present People/account/household/qualification consumers. Later team/training, attendance/RSVP/card/kit, follow-up/task/contact, communication, Launch guest, documents and Evry proposal/artifact owners add registrations and real merge/retirement/inverse fixtures before their own closure. Immutable historical actor/event/document snapshots retain original provenance with authorized identity lineage rather than arbitrary rewrite. `people.getMergeReview` returns exact current reviewed state, all differing stored field choices, account/household/photo/current-lifecycle effects, moved/deduplicated references and named blockers. Recheck both live same-plant Persons and affected records; one atomic merge updates survivor/reference projections, retires source, records original snapshots, choices, exact moved records, before/after values and conditions for a safe inverse, appends history, audit and the recorded outcome and makes affected assessments stale. Two account-linked Persons cannot merge; the linked Person must survive, account grants/author identity cannot move, and no arbitrary storage/user ID enters the payload. Conservative collisions include same-meeting attendance/card, active training assignment/completion, pending RSVP, distinct live obligation, referral cycle and conflicting household/leadership state; disclose exact conflicts rather than silently dropping records. Repeated same merge returns original recorded outcome; conflicting destination or stale review refuses; source redirects follow recorded acyclic lineage.

Retain the required Unmerge capability through `people.previewUnmerge`/`people.unmergePeople`, both native and exact-reviewed Evry. The preview names the original merge and full inverse. Execute only when recorded survivor/field/photo/account/reference reviewed facts are unchanged and every manifest inverse/uniqueness/tenant check proves restoration without discarding later facts. Under the same unchanged-review and ownership checks restore source and recorded moved/deduplicated references, restore prior survivor values, append a new reversal outcome and attributable history/audit that make affected assessments stale; retain the original merge receipt. Retrying reversal converges. A source-row-only restore is never Unmerge. A chained merge, new/corrected reference, credential/author conflict, sent-mail/disclosure or other irreversible effect whose attribution cannot be safely reversed causes exact conflict refusal with zero inverse effects. Offer separately reviewed manual correction/split of named records within ordinary domain authority, preserving later history and original authorship; operator recovery is not a substitute for the safe native inverse and never unsends mail. No universal undo promise. Organization pipeline Persons use the same applicable identity, lifecycle, duplicate, merge, reference and inverse rules within their exact organization under REQ-MUL-001 and REQ-MUL-005; plant-only recruitment/household/commitment facts remain plant-only.

Record explicit adult_classification=adult|child|unknown with dated attributable correction history; DOB is optional and never required. Maintain authoritative per-person/plant commitment lifecycle active|withdrawn|unknown, separate from signature rows and stage. At frozen asOf/source revision, count each live same plant classified adult with currently active supported core-group or launch-team commitment once, regardless of repeated cards, ministry roles or account link. Two eligible household adults count two; role/stage/account alone supplies no evidence. Known children, current withdrawal, retired/merged-away sources and foreign records are excluded with lineage. Unknown classification/state is visible. Exact count is available only with complete evidence; 30 established adults meet≥30 even with a partial cohort, 29 plus a consequential unknown yields Unknown, reliably bounded below 30 may fail while exact count stays unknown; unavailable read is never zero. No blanket classify-every-contact or renewal gate.

Historical genuine acquisition is independent from current size. Use each canonical person's earliest valid actual eligible commitment occurrence, not recorded/corrected/classified/rejoined time. A real withdrawal decreases current size but preserves its genuine acquisition and the latest-first acquisition clock; later genuine reactivation restores current size without a new person or clock reset. Correcting an invalid historical event/date may remove/move that acquisition and recompute current windows/clock with old/new/actor/reason history. The 2026-10-13 15:32 semantic ruling expressly settles this difference. Deduplicate through explicit merge lineage, never similar name/email. Preserve trailing 28 day versus prior 28 day first-acquisition counts: net current headcount and growthDelta do not define the flat clock. 20 days permits neither slowed nor stalled, 21–27 permits slowed only,≥28 permits stalled and fails the established growth-trajectory test. Missing/invalid/future consequential occurrence evidence leaves timing Unknown, independently of known size. All date/window boundaries use frozen church-local LocalDate, with windows [ asOf -27, asOf ] and [ asOf -55, asOf -28]; no UTC-midnight reinterpretation. Old assessments retain their formula/asOf/source lineage.

requirements.title: Pipeline duty authority and restricted projections
requirements.text: A current exact-organization Owner or Admin can administer its pipeline. Assigned responsible staff and program directors must hold a current eligible seat in that organization and receive only their named duties. A linked resident has only their own residency projection, without an organization seat or directory access. Internal stage labels, reasons, staff conversation notes, assessment metadata and inactivity flags are hidden from residents. No director or organization role gains plant editing, account-private documents, reflections, private-care bodies or existence signals. Central audit contains IDs, actor, change kind and revisions, never protected note, reason or feedback bodies. The S0 portion proves exact duty decisions and restricted note projections against supplied records. Rendering pipeline stage labels is a later WP-098 projection; program directors do not gain responsible-staff note access merely by directing a program.

requirements.title: Resident consent and revocation foundation
requirements.text: An accepted resident link records separate choices for sharing six-foundation completion and resident milestone progress with the exact organization. Disclose categories and excluded private content before acceptance; acceptance grants only explicitly chosen categories. The resident can stop either category or leave. Withdrawal takes effect immediately in current reads, exports, saved results, history, jobs, source bytes and model context; stale consent revisions fail. Account-private reading and documents remain account-owned. A link neither creates a seat nor consumes another seat. An ended link cannot be revived by replaying an invitation or an old approval. Enrollment facts the organization independently owns remain subject to its removal policy; consent loss does not erase genuine organizational facts.

requirements.title: Organization invitation to a resident account
requirements.text: An organization Owner or Admin may invite a specific pipeline person to link an EveryField account. Use sealed, expiring, purpose-bound invitation proof, the exact organization and Person, and verified addressed-account acceptance. Names or matching emails alone never authorize a link. The person sees the disclosure and accepts or declines without acquiring a seat. Decline leaves their account unchanged. Revoke, resend, retire, remove, concurrent claim and expiry recheck current facts at commit; one accepted link and receipt survive retries, never two accounts or two people. Public invitation responses do not reveal whether an account exists. A pending personal deletion or foreign owner refuses acceptance.

requirements.title: Organization pipeline export and removal
requirements.text: An exact-organization Owner or Admin exports current authorized pipeline contact, stage history, program and attributable completion facts in a safe downloadable format. Export omits account-private content and any note, reason, feedback or progress category unavailable to the current reader; recheck authority and consent when producing and downloading bytes. On a person removal request, remove identifiable pipeline/contact bodies and unnecessary note, reason and feedback bodies, revoke links and source access, and retain only independently needed organization facts with minimal scope-local attribution. Report retained categories and why. Retirement is not removal. No permanent history exception, fixed new retention period or account 30-day cancellation period applies to organization pipeline records. Account removal severs account links and purges account-private originals without erasing independently needed organization facts. Recovery must reapply removal and revocation witnesses before service reopens.

requirements.title: Residency handoff interface preserves ordinary creation
requirements.text: The foundation creation interface accepts only account-owner-confirmed values and preserves ordinary Phase 1 entry, one active seat and an attributable creation event. A sending organization cannot create or edit the plant on the resident's behalf. Residency commissioning, plant prefill and lineage are deferred to ADR delivery stage 3. Future handoff must explicitly resolve an existing organization staff seat; an Owner follows the existing manual exceptional ownership process. No seat-transfer engine or silent geographic attestation is introduced.

requirements.title: Sending goals and observed counts
requirements.text: Both sending churches and sending networks may record multiple goals with nonnegative leader and plant targets, target year and rationale. At a stated as-of instant in the organization timezone, show own-pipeline counts by each fixed stage kind: count distinct live same-organization people whose current pipeline stage has that kind. A person appears once; retired or merged people and foreign organizations do not count. Also show active residents: distinct live same-organization people with at least one active enrollment in a residency-kind program; apprenticeship enrollment and the editable pipeline label alone do not qualify. Multiple active residency programs still count the person once. These are current observations, not forecasts, readiness scores or an undefined total of leaders. Plant targets may be stored, but observed plants sent is unavailable with reason deferred_stage_3 until commissioning/lineage arrives in stage 3; do not substitute zero or count Commissioned-kind people as plants. Aggregate church/network sharing remains stage 4. A goal never moves a person, commissions an enrollment or creates a plant.

requirements.title: Configurable human pipeline stages
requirements.text: Start with Potential leader, Apprentice, Resident, Commissioned and Not continuing. Owners and Admins may rename, reorder and add stages mapped to the fixed kinds potential_leader, apprentice, resident, commissioned, not_continuing or other. Show exact changes for review before saving. Refuse deletion of occupied stages and retain old labels in dated history. A human records each move and its reason; no automatic recruitment event or program completion moves an organization person. Not continuing is an ordinary outcome. Record only whether an outside assessment occurred, when and by whom, never its outcome. Staff may query people with no move for six months using the stated calendar and as-of date. Counts use kinds, not editable labels. Evry may propose only the selected Person and destination stage identities. The proposal does not move anyone and accepts no note, reason or other free text. A human completes an exact native review and supplies the required reason outside model/conversation input; the native move rechecks current authority and revisions.

requirements.title: Leadership conversations
requirements.text: Current authorized staff log who met whom and the actual conversation date. Count conversations in the organization timezone by month or quarter. The optional short note is readable only by the organization Owner, Admins and the person currently responsible. Other staff may receive permitted counts, never note contents or existence through filtering, search or exports. Resident projections omit staff notes. Conversation notes never enter model input, including calls made by an otherwise authorized reader. Changes retain attributable correction history without judging a person. Logging leadership conversations is human-only. Organization ordinary Person notes use the same Owner/Admin or responsible-staff audience and never enter models. Only the original author with current exact-organization duty may update or remove such a note; removal clears the body and retains only necessary attributable body-free history.

requirements.title: Apprenticeship and residency program definitions
requirements.text: Both apprenticeship and residency programs ship before alpha for either organization kind. Define director, meeting rhythm, expected length, ordered stages with editable month ranges, milestones and Wiki reading lists. Start blank or from the residency template: Assimilating 2 to 3 months, Training and planning 6 to 9 months, Gathering 2 to 3 months, Sending and planting 2 to 3 months. Offer milestones to start a small group and raise a replacement, present the vision to sending leadership and write a church planting prospectus. Directors review drafts before publication. Publishing a changed plan creates a new version; existing enrollments keep their plan unless the director deliberately reviews and applies the version. Reading pointers pin canonical article and revision and recheck current source entitlement; organization content never grants general library access.

requirements.title: Enrollment, cohort and deliberate plan changes
requirements.text: Enroll an active same-organization pipeline person in a program and cohort with start, expected end, current program stage, status and next meeting with timezone. A person may have different programs but cannot have duplicate active enrollment in the same program. Enrollment fixes the published version and its milestones. A director may explicitly apply a reviewed new version to selected enrollments, preserving attributable completion/confirmation history and exposing added, removed or changed work. Reject foreign person, director, program or stage and changed reviewed states. Current program stages are distinct from internal pipeline stages.

requirements.title: Resident completion, director confirmation and feedback
requirements.text: A currently linked resident marks their own milestone complete; the current program director confirms separately. Resident completion never supplies director confirmation. For an enrollee without a current accepted resident link in this organization, the current program director may instead record the enrollee completion and confirm it in one dated, attributable native action. That action records the director as recorder and confirmer, the actual completion instant and confirmation instant, and a program-leader-recorded source; the enrolled Person remains the subject. It creates no account link or seat and cannot be used while a current resident link exists. Recheck link status at commit, so a concurrent acceptance refuses this path and requires the linked-resident flow. A subsequent link does not rewrite prior director-recorded facts. Retain correction history for each fact. Hands-on assignments are described milestones; dated feedback is visible only to the linked resident, current director and organization Owner/Admin of either kind. Other staff and foreign residents cannot read feedback. Feedback does not judge calling. Recheck duty, version, link and consent at use. Neither completion path automatically commissions or creates a plant.

requirements.title: My residency without a seat
requirements.text: A linked Discovery account keeps its private Wiki reading and documents and gains My residency showing its program, current program stage, next meeting, own milestones and confirmation state, entitled reading list and exact sharing controls. It can mark its own milestone done, stop sharing or leave. It cannot see the internal pipeline label, reasons, staff notes, assessment metadata or six-month inactivity flag. It receives no People, Meetings, Tasks, Launch, organization directory, plant workspace or second seat. Current link loss removes the projection immediately, including cached navigation and downloads.

requirements.title: Consented foundations and reading sources
requirements.text: A director sees only the linked resident's consented completion facts for the six canonical Discovery foundations and permitted milestone progress. Do not return private reading rows, reflections or documents. Foundation completion means one eligible actual reader completed all six above the existing threshold; do not pool readers or infer completion from a program milestone. Program reading uses current entitled canonical sources, including the organization's published versions. Withdrawal, link termination, source unpublication or lost relationship access removes content and shared progress from current results, history and downloadable bytes. Linking does not broaden Discovery reading rights to unrelated organization libraries.

requirements.title: Pipeline and residency Evry boundaries
requirements.text: Evry may read authorized pipeline facts and draft program plans and milestone lists. Every durable write uses exact human review of all effects and fresh authority, reference, revision and consent checks at execution. Native and assistant calls have the same results and denials. Staff may ask who has not moved in six months. Evry never ranks people, assesses calling or reads leadership conversation notes into a model; it also excludes private care, internal reasons, assessment metadata and assignment feedback unless a separately reviewed model-safe allowlist explicitly authorizes a category. Program drafting never publishes or enrolls without reviewed effects. Agreement and commissioning drafts remain deferred with delivery stage 3. Conversation logging and reason-bearing stage moves are native-only. A bounded stage-move proposal accepts only Person and destination stage identities and refuses any note/reason/free-text field. It returns a draft with no durable effect; human review collects the reason outside the conversation/model and commits the native operation. Model context and receipts omit that human-only body.

requirements.title: Network sharing boundary and deferred delivery
requirements.text: A sending-church Owner or Admin may opt in to sharing pipeline totals separately for each current network relationship and withdraw immediately. Default is off. Share only aggregate stage-kind counts, active residents and commissioned counts by year, never individual candidates, notes, reasons, feedback, assessment metadata or private progress. A network result requires at least two currently contributing organizations; hide unavailable contributions rather than substituting zero or allowing subtraction, filters, saved history or stale jobs to identify a single church or person. A network's own pipeline confers no right to a church's pipeline. Aggregate delivery, network-defined church stages and revised Network Intelligence inputs remain deferred to ADR stage 4; S0 establishes only consent/revocation categories and minimum-contributor rules. The S0 eligibility check returns only an allowed/withheld decision and the minimum contributor rule, without totals or individual records; it rechecks current opt-ins and refuses fewer than two distinct contributors.

requirements.title: Organization duplicates, merge and guarded Unmerge
requirements.text: In S1, reuse the Person correction and merge producer for organization-owned identities. Duplicate suggestions never prove identity or choose a survivor automatically. An exact-organization Owner or Admin reviews the selected source, survivor and field choices. Merge requires reviewed field choices, current reviewed state and same-owner identities, preserves historical endpoints and refuses linked-account, enrollment or other current-reference collisions. Unmerge restores only the exact reviewed prior state and refuses conflicting edits, new references or irreversible disclosure. No merge or inverse transfers account consent, private care, note authorship or organization/plant authority. Register downstream enrollment, stage-history and resident-link collisions before those consumers close.
